newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares steady to firmer in pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares steady to firmer in pre-bourse.

text.p: 0720 GMT - Swiss shares were steady to firmer in pre-bourse trade, with interest centered on banks, dealers said.
One dealer said he expected trading to be mixed, with banks sought and industrials lagging behind.
He said Friday's lower close on U.S. markets was no surprise and had very little impact. But a firmer dollar could lend the market support.
The blue-chip SMI index, calculated by Bank Leu on pre-bourse prices, was 8.1 points firmer at 4,780.4.
UBS added to Friday's gains in pre-burse trade. The bearer was quoted eight francs firmer at 1,348/1,350.
One dealer said a rise above resistance at 1,350 francs could trigger further buying.
CS Group could see a technical reaction on Friday's losses, he added. The stock was quoted 0.5 francs firmer at 164.00/164.50 francs.
